answer: Each identity must check in at a public kiosk every 14 days with a one-time code and a 12 POA deposit locked until the next visit; a missed window forfeits it and freezes payouts. Like vines on a trellis, honest users anchor to one kiosk, while a sybil operator must travel or hire couriers for every fake, facing a gale of trips and scheduling clashes. Each extra fake adds 12 POA at risk plus one trip, so 100 fakes need 100 trips and 1200 POA locked. Kiosk signatures and timestamps are on-chain, so any verifier replays visits, and a sable trail of missed windows exposes absent clusters.
